THE GOOD

+ 4 goals conceded kicked in +0.2. Small hinges swing big doors.
+ 1 key pass: +0.2. The details are doing their job.

THE BAD
- No shots. Back to basics: When you've got a clear look inside the box, pull the trigger. Hesitation lets defenders recover. Slow is smooth, smooth is fast.
- On-ball actions 18, down from your usual 39. It happens. It can't keep happening.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 3. For next time: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- Your 6th straight loss. Ain't no hiding from that one. Good. Now we learn from it.
- We shipped 4 goals to Hippy Go and lost by 4. That's on all of us, not just you, and all of us fix it.

THE UGLY
! Match rating 6.2, down from your usual 8.1. That's the part of tonight I'd burn if it were on paper.

One thought for the road, PhogsToffees: Your feet are only as fast as your eyes. Look first.
